summary: All 25 task-04 Playwright tests passed in Chromium, including seven new adversarial regressions covering permission races, pending tidy cancellation, stop-time speech thresholds, malformed responses, network failure, and startup errors. node tests/verify.js and node tests/dictate.js passed. node tests/idea.js still has its documented pre-existing toolbar-order failure; its other checks passed. No task-04 product bug was found. The required test commit could not be created because Git was unable to create .git/index.lock on the read-only filesystem; the command was attempted once and not retried. The test changes and this report remain uncommitted, so this round is marked fail for the delivery blocker. Transcription responses were stubbed; real Groq language detection was not tested.
